subject.title: refactor(config): config-surface reduction tranche 3 — product consolidations (review request)

question: Should a previously explicit `systemAgent.rescue.enabled: false` choice continue to disable owner-DM remote rescue after this consolidation, or should qualifying YOLO hosts become unconditionally rescue-enabled?
rationale: The patch intentionally removes the only operator-controlled denial while preserving a remotely reachable local-repair surface; source review cannot decide whether that upgrade-time security and operator-control change is acceptable.

options.title: Preserve the explicit opt-out
options.body: Keep a supported fail-closed denial setting or migrate legacy `enabled: false` into an equivalent canonical control, with focused Doctor and policy tests.

options.title: Retire the opt-out intentionally
options.body: Approve automatic owner-DM rescue for all qualifying YOLO hosts, document that existing explicit denials are superseded, and add upgrade proof for that deliberate change.

recommendation.title: Preserve the explicit opt-out
recommendation.body: Keep a supported fail-closed denial setting or migrate legacy `enabled: false` into an equivalent canonical control, with focused Doctor and policy tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR author explicitly requested the product calls and owns the final-head configuration consolidation work.
